name: Inside Zone Read Give
formation: Gun Spread Right Slot, TE Right

summary.motive: Make the backside end choose between the quarterback and the A-gap, then punish the crash with an instant downhill give.
summary.whyItWorks: Spread spacing forces the end to declare immediately, and his aggression toward the keeper opens the exact lane the offset back is already attacking.
summary.failureMode: The end squeezes square and spills, clogging the give while staying connected enough to contest a late pull.

beats.title: 1. The Read and the Crash
beats.text: The quarterback seats the mesh with eyes locked on the unblocked backside end. The end fires inside hunting the keeper instead of squeezing the gap.

beats.title: 2. The Give Branch
beats.text: The crash declares the answer instantly: the ball goes into the belly of a back who is already at full forward lean through the vacated A-gap.

beats.title: 3. Downhill Finish
beats.text: The back presses downhill behind the scoop-and-climb guard while the quarterback sells the boot fake the other way, pinning the pursuit.

beats.title: 4. The Boot Fake Sells
beats.text: With the Mike scooped and both safeties triggering on the fake keeper, the give finishes vertically through the open middle field.

relations.tell: The ball leaves the quarterback's hands before his shoulders ever turn — a true keep rides through the mesh point.
